title: Answer: neuroscience of conscious and nonconscious states, attention and memory

statements.text: What can be checked is how the brain does what the folk concepts describe: the neurophysiological differences between conscious and nonconscious states, sleep, attention, memory and learning, by single-cell recording, lesion studies, functional imaging and ethology. The lesson is to learn the science, do the science and see what happens.
